panels.title: LIVE (~15s): steps/s, breaks, logs
panels.description: The heartbeat feed — a thin record written every ~15s from the per-step hook, so the run is watchable between segments. Segment records stay the authoritative per-segment observation; this is running totals sampled mid-segment. Separate table, so the two cadences never mix in one series.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT wall_time AS time, steps_per_s, breaks_total, logs, attack_run FROM heartbeat ORDER BY wall_time
SELECT steps_per_s FROM heartbeat ORDER BY wall_time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: BREAKS PER LOG  (the scoreboard — history is 399:1)
panels.description: Blocks broken per log obtained. This, not reward, is whether SkyBot is learning the thing it exists to learn. CLAUDE.md §9: 'the reward number has been wrong every single time.' Null means no log has ever dropped.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT breaks_per_log FROM segments WHERE breaks_per_log IS NOT NULL ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Reward concentration (HHI)
panels.description: Herfindahl index over reward sources. 1.0 = one source owns all income, which is what every historical farm looked like: sky 96% of drive, a menu 77% of income. Rising HHI is the early warning.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT reward_hhi FROM segments ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Players online (expect num_envs)
panels.description: -1 IS NOT A BUG. server_poll.py records -1 when the Paper server is UNREACHABLE, deliberately: 'a down server is a data point, not an error', and skipping the write would leave a gap indistinguishable from the poller dying. The REASON is in `version`, which reads 'unreachable: <ExceptionName>' -- that column was not shown, so -1 looked like a broken gauge. A sustained -1 usually means MC_HOST in the monitor .env is stale (it held the dead RunPod address until 2026-09-28). Expect 2 when healthy: SkyBot and SkyBot1 are distinct players on an offline-mode server.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT players_online, version, wall_time FROM server ORDER BY wall_time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Where the reward comes from (live, ~15s)
panels.description: Shares of |reward| by source, from the HEARTBEAT (~15s) not the segment record (~10 min). Previously this hardcoded six json_extract keys and silently dropped the rest -- which is why it never summed to 1 and why `imagination` was invisible while it took 69% of income during the cave incident. `other` is the residual: if it is non-zero, a reward source exists that this panel does not name.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT wall_time AS time, json_extract(income_now,'$.imagination') AS imagination, json_extract(income_now,'$.symbols') AS symbols, json_extract(income_now,'$.novelty') AS novelty, json_extract(income_now,'$.gaze') AS gaze, json_extract(income_now,'$.effort') AS effort, json_extract(income_now,'$.coverage') AS coverage, json_extract(income_now,'$.magnet_seek') AS magnet_seek, json_extract(income_now,'$.reach') AS reach, json_extract(income_now,'$.progress') AS progress, json_extract(income_now,'$.persistence') AS persistence, json_extract(income_now,'$.log_break') AS log_break, json_extract(income_now,'$.icm_base') AS icm_base, 1.0 - (COALESCE(json_extract(income_now,'$.imagination'),0) + COALESCE(json_extract(income_now,'$.symbols'),0) + COALESCE(json_extract(income_now,'$.novelty'),0) + COALESCE(json_extract(income_now,'$.gaze'),0) + COALESCE(json_extract(income_now,'$.effort'),0) + COALESCE(json_extract(income_now,'$.coverage'),0) + COALESCE(json_extract(income_now,'$.magnet_seek'),0) + COALESCE(json_extract(income_now,'$.reach'),0) + COALESCE(json_extract(income_now,'$.progress'),0) + COALESCE(json_extract(income_now,'$.persistence'),0) + COALESCE(json_extract(income_now,'$.log_break'),0) + COALESCE(json_extract(income_now,'$.icm_base'),0)) AS other FROM heartbeat WHERE income_now IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wall_time
SELECT wall_time AS time, breaks_total, logs FROM segments ORDER BY wall_time

SELECT je.key AS block, CAST(je.value AS INTEGER) AS broken FROM segments s, json_each(s.breaks_by_type) je WHERE s.seq = (SELECT MAX(seq) FROM segments WHERE breaks_by_type IS NOT NULL AND breaks_by_type != '{}') ORDER BY broken DESC

SELECT je.key AS item, CAST(je.value AS INTEGER) AS crafted FROM segments s, json_each(s.crafts_by_type) je WHERE s.seq = (SELECT MAX(seq) FROM segments WHERE crafts_by_type IS NOT NULL AND crafts_by_type != '{}') ORDER BY crafted DESC

panels.title: Skills: minted vs bound vs refused
panels.description: The competence gate once froze at 16 skills / 0 invocations FOREVER, invisible for days. Minted rising while bound stays flat is that failure returning.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT wall_time AS time, skills_minted, skills_bound, skills_refused, rssm_no_latent FROM segments ORDER BY wall_time

panels.title: Learning signals (entropy, WM loss, KL, intrinsic)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT wall_time AS time, policy_entropy, world_model_loss, kl_divergence, intrinsic_reward, symbolic_decoder_accuracy FROM segments ORDER BY wall_time

panels.description: Read from training_metrics, not from the segment dict. The first version queried policy_entropy/curiosity/world_model_loss out of episode_metrics, where none of them exist, so the panel was empty for a whole run. `curiosity` is not emitted at all — intrinsic_reward is the real signal.

panels.title: Reward + attack behaviour
panels.description: attack_run_max is how long it holds attack without a break. 96% of option activity once went into holding attack on an unreachable trunk, producing 0 logs.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT wall_time AS time, episode_reward, intrinsic_reward, attack_run_max, attack_run_mean FROM segments ORDER BY wall_time
